recipe.title: Gourmet Broccoli Gratin with Aged Cheddar & Smoked Gouda
recipe.description: A rich, velvety keto gratin featuring tender blanched broccoli folded into a garlic-infused cream sauce and melted artisan cheeses, finished with a golden crispy top.

ingredients.item: salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and lightly grease a small 1-quart baking dish.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Blanch the broccoli florets for 2-3 minutes until tender-crisp. Drain thoroughly and pat completely dry with paper towels.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant without browning.
Reduce heat to low and whisk in the heavy whipping cream and softened cream cheese until smooth and warm.
Stir in 3/4 cup of sharp cheddar and 1/4 cup of smoked gouda until melted into a rich sauce. Season with nutmeg, salt, and black pepper.
Gently fold the blanched broccoli florets into the cheese sauce until thoroughly coated, then transfer the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar, smoked gouda, and crumbled bacon.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the top is lightly golden brown. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

tips: Drying the broccoli thoroughly after blanching prevents excess moisture from thinning out the creamy cheese sauce.
Shred your own cheese from blocks to avoid added starches and anti-caking agents found in pre-shredded bags.
